thread:
maria.design: Dropped a new compact Alerting preview in Figma — goal: single-line rows, suppression control discoverable, keyboard + SR parity. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZ (frame: compact-preview-v1)

june.pm: Nice. Main question: inline pill vs hover panel? Panel allows copy but might clip on narrow sidebars.

maria.design: Proposal: hover panel by default; fall back to inline pill when width < 320px. Keyboard should open panel with Enter/Space.

kai.eng: We'll render the panel in a portal to avoid clipping. Use `aria-expanded` on the opener and roving tabindex for predictable row nav.

lena.a11y: For AT announce after DOM ready: "Preview opened: <channel>. Suppression: on/off." Use polite live region and delay ~60ms post-mount to avoid announcing during animation.

noah.product: Copy debate: "Quiet window" vs "Snooze" — ops likes quiet, product leans snooze. Recommend quick usability test.

maria.design: Adding both variants to research frames. Also badge contrast is borderline: BG #F6F8FF + text #6B7280 fails AA at 12px.

kai.eng: Swap to tokens BG #EEF2FF and FG #374151 and add 3px focus ring token. We'll include `data-testid` attributes for QA.

lena.a11y: Snackbars should use `role=\"status\"` and Undo must be keyboard focusable. Add SR test steps.

june.pm: UX on toggle: optimistic update + small undo snackbar (6s) — fast but reversible.

maria.design: Good. Handoff checklist: portal rendering note, aria-live pattern (RAF+60ms), token swap, optimistic toggle+undo, `data-testid` on key controls. I'll push frames + checklist by EOD. :sparkles:
